_comment: Copy this to backup-config.json (git-ignored) and edit. See BACKUP.md.
_dest_note: UNC path to the NAS share, or any local/mapped folder. In JSON every backslash is doubled, so \\NAS\share is written \\\\NAS\\share. A mapped drive letter (Z:/backups/basic) is fine when running interactively, but Task Scheduler often cannot see mapped drives — prefer the UNC path there.
_retention_note: Keeps the last keepDaily runs, plus the first run of each of the last keepMonthly months. Everything else is deleted after a successful run.
_exclude_note: Extra collections to skip, on top of catalog/jobphotos/pmsphotos/sessions. ["portal"] roughly halves the runtime — portal docs are rebuildable from vehicles+jobs, but there is no bulk republish tool, so customer QR pages would stay blank until each vehicle is saved again. The manifest records whatever was excluded.
_pageSize_note: Documents per read request. Reads run at single-digit KB/s over a shop connection, and one unbounded read of the jobs collection exceeds Firestore's 300s deadline. Lower this if you still see DEADLINE_EXCEEDED; raise it on a fast link to reduce round-trips.
